dispositions.reason: 'The total amount of any reduction(s) pursuant to this Section 11.5(b) shall in no event exceed [...***...] percent ([...***...]%) of the Product Price ... (with the right to carry forward any unused offset).' THE SUBJECT IS 'The total amount' -- a quantity, not a party -- and 'shall in no event exceed' states a CAP on the offset right C04-11 annotates, not conduct required of anyone. §8.8's named non-party-subject class; same ground as C17-038's 'shall survive' and C02-062's event-subject savings clause, and the same shape as C04-180's 'all such counterparts ... shall constitute one and the same agreement'. NOBODY IS TOLD TO DO OR REFRAIN FROM ANYTHING: the sentence bounds how large a permitted offset may be. The trailing parenthetical '(with the right to carry forward any unused offset)' is a further grant of the same right C04-11 already carries, not a separate duty, and is absorbed here rather than dispositioned separately -- it has no subject or modal of its own. NOTE: this sentence carries two of the segment's three redactions ([1613:1624] and [1634:1645]); because it is not an item, no §8.1 question is reached for either.
